evidence.description: The input data shows all 96 rows are scheduled='yes'; the 24 excluded rows are excluded only by screen_status='omitted' and carry NA occurrence flags, so they are in-domain scheduled units with unobserved outcomes.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to falsify the mismatch by looking for any statement that redefines the scientific target as the screened subset, which would place the case under the explicit conditional-target exception. The task line demands a rate for 'the entire scheduled survey network'; the report's target line names all 96 scheduled stations; the selected-result sentence itself repeats 'for the entire scheduled survey network'; and the protocol-status line denies any amendment or approved deviation. I also tested whether the omitted 24 rows might be out of domain, but every such row records scheduled='yes' with screen_status='omitted' and occurrence_flag=NA, i.e. in-domain but unobserved. No conditional restatement exists, so the falsification attempt fails and the complete-domain requirement stands against a 72-station denominator.

root_cause: The workflow hard-codes SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS (72) as the divisor in the selected-result line while the target and claim text assert the complete scheduled network (96); the 24 screen-omitted stations, which carry NA occurrence flags in the input, are silently dropped from the exposure denominator rather than retained as unobserved scheduled units.
